finding.title: SkillGen's official Git/release surface fixes the ScienceWorld split and paired-verification code but does not publish the generated paired run bundle
finding.observation: The complete current tree and the original code commit tree both contain the exact ScienceWorld train/test datasets and paired-verification implementation, but no skill_output run directory, effectiveness baseline/with-skill JSONL, paired summary JSON, final generated skill artifact, or other run-output package is present. The repository has no GitHub releases. This closes the primary official Git/release surface more strongly than a filename search alone.
finding.scope_guard: This is limited to the official yccm/SkillGen Git history surfaces inspected here. It does not rule out an author mirror, supplementary archive, paper artifact host or later publication of run outputs. It also does not weaken the paper-level paired-intervention evidence; it only blocks zero-execution re-audit of the reported ScienceWorld trials from the currently published official run bytes.

phase1_cost_assessment.reason: The inspected live pipeline requires model/API execution; Phase-1 accepts only static public artifact inspection here.
